title: Priority cannot bypass input
hook: The important output cannot run before its input exists.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Distinguish task priority from prerequisite readiness.

objective: Distinguish task priority from prerequisite readiness.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: The important output cannot run before its input exists. Which order respects the stated dependency? Correct option: Draft before review. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.

All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred. claims.text: The review requires the draft to be finished. A high priority label changes neither that prerequisite nor the input release time.

recall.question: 'Send invoice' is top priority but needs a signed quote first. Which order is possible?
options: Send the invoice first; it is top priority
Get the quote, then send the invoice
Do both at the same moment
recall.why: A priority label does not remove a prerequisite; the invoice cannot go before its input exists.
